args.issue_title: Retry transient S3 throttling in the archive uploader
args.issue_body:
Uploads to the archive bucket fail intermittently during nightly batch
runs. Sentry shows 41 ClientError(SlowDown) events between 02:00 and 03:00 UTC
with no retry attempted, so the whole batch aborts on the first throttle.

Expected: transient S3 throttling should be retried with backoff.
Actual: a single SlowDown aborts the run and the remaining files are skipped.
args.brief:
The archive uploader has no retry path. S3 throttling (SlowDown) is
expected under burst load and is documented as retryable. Two call sites use
`upload_with_retry`; both are batch paths where a bounded retry is safe. No
idempotency concern: put_object with the same key is idempotent.
args.guidance: Name the retryable code set explicitly and state the idempotency assumption.
